content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a [product_name] controller that manages several motors, and I want to link this device to a [product_name] SCADA system, version [version_no]. Is this possible? Thanks.
As far as I know, this is not possible. The [product_name] controller only integrates with [product_name] Flexible and [product_name] TIA Portal.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to connect a [product_name] controller to a [product_name] SCADA system ([version_no]) for motor monitoring, but is told these versions are not compatible. The main insight is that compatibility issues between products are not clearly known until setup is attempted, leading to user uncertainty when planning integrations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward connectivity and monitoring between their [product_name] controller and the [product_name] SCADA system ([version_no]) without requiring any adaptation.
